scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @goease/contracts && concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev --workspace @goease/client" "npm run dev --workspace @goease/server"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @goease/contracts && npm run build --workspace @goease/server && npm run build --workspace @goease/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @goease/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @goease/contracts && npm run test --workspace @goease/server
